title: When Does a Cross-Device Run Justify PASS? Obligation-Level Evidence Qualification under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2611.06013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A cross-device test can complete every command yet judge a business claim from evidence belonging to another device or attempt. We introduce an executable evidence contract that makes support qualification an explicit stage before predicate evaluation. It binds each obligation to admissible subjects, episodes, objects and observation scopes, and records unresolved support rather than treating an apparently successful observation as proof.   We evaluate two implemented parts of the contract. A prospectively specified, 12-seed controlled study isolates association under reused identifiers across 2,304 claims. Given identical records and business policy, Atomic-Facts Flat produces 160 false PASS and 76.30% PASS recall; supplying computed associations reduces false PASS to five and increases PASS recall to 99.09%. translated_title: 跨设备运行何时才足以判定 PASS？部分可观测性下的义务级证据资格认定
translated_abstract: 跨设备测试可能完成每一条命令，却依据来自另一设备或另一次尝试的证据来判定业务声明。我们引入一种可执行的证据契约，将支持资格认定作为谓词求值之前的显式阶段。该契约将每项义务绑定到可采纳的主体、情节、对象和观测范围，并记录未获解决的支持情况，而不是把表面上成功的观测直接当作证明。我们评估了该契约中已实现的两部分。在一项前瞻性设定、12个种子的受控研究中，针对2,304条声明隔离了标识符复用下的关联问题。在给定相同记录和业务策略的情况下，Atomic-Facts Flat 方法产生160个假 PASS，PASS 召回率为76.30%；而提供计算得到的关联后，假 PASS 降至5个，PASS 召回率提升至99.09%。Deterministic Closure 方法则实现零假 PASS 和100.00%的 PASS 召回率，在11个种子上优于 Atomic Flat，其中一次持平（摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种可执行的证据契约，将证据支持资格认定作为判定求值前的显式阶段，通过把义务绑定到可采纳的主体、情节、对象和观测范围并记录未解决的支持，有效防止跨设备测试中因采用其他设备或尝试的证据而产生的假 PASS 判定。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an executable evidence contract that makes support qualification an explicit stage before predicate evaluation, binding each obligation to admissible subjects, episodes, objects, and observation scopes to prevent false PASS verdicts caused by evidence from other devices or attempts under partial observability.
